audit.whatIsWrong: Judgment is labelled as Garen's W in three places: spikes[0].text ("spinning Judgment (W) shreds you in melee"), mid ("Q silence into Judgment (W)"), and wants.foe[1] ("Shred you inside spinning Judgment (W)"). Judgment is Garen's E. His W is Courage.
audit.why: The ability name is right, so the suspectNames scan passed it — it only compares names, not the slot letter attached to them. The consequence is real: the full layer correctly tells the player to track Courage, so the two layers together tell a player that the spin and the damage-reduction shield are the same button.
audit.corrected: Relabelled Judgment as (E) in all three strings.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text says Demacian Justice scales "with his missing HP" and that "Villain marks amplify it"; mid repeats the Villain claim with "don't feed his Villain mark".
audit.why: Two errors in one sentence. The execute scales with the target's missing health, not Garen's — the text has the direction backwards, which inverts the actual safety rule. And Villain is not part of Garen's kit: Riot's current Demacian Justice text is just "Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to attempt to execute an enemy champion", with no marking mechanic. This is the same class of stale-mechanic error as the Adrenaline reference I found in the Dr. Mundo entry.
audit.corrected: Restated the execute as scaling with the player's own missing health and removed both Villain references.
sources: champ-data/_kits/garen.json (Demacian Justice; no Villain mechanic in the current description)

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged this matchup as having no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and that was accurate — every cooldown reference was the generic "track Courage" template with no number and no ordering.
audit.why: There are three concrete sequencing rules available from the kits and none were stated. Courage is 22s at rank 1 and grants tenacity plus damage reduction, so committing into a fresh Courage means a shortened knockup and a blunted combo. Decisive Strike is 8s and breaks free of all slows, so any plan built on kiting with Zac's Q or R slow is dead on arrival. And Perseverance only regenerates when Garen has not recently been struck, so Zac's W on a 5s cooldown shuts it off entirely.
audit.corrected: Added all three as explicit wait-for-X-before-Y lines in breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid and breakdown.early.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early says Garen's "passive regen erases any poke you land", which frames poking as futile.
audit.why: Perseverance regenerates only if Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities. Poke does not get erased — poke is what turns the passive off. Zac's W is a 5s-cooldown AoE, which means he can deny Perseverance essentially permanently while farming. The entry told the player the opposite of the correct plan.
audit.corrected: Rewrote to say the regen only ticks while untouched, so W chip shuts it down.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer awards Zac levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items (sides Skill/Zac/Zac/Skill/Skill/Zac/Zac) in a lane he loses at 46.48% over 284 games, while the content chart gives Garen six of seven stages.
audit.why: This is Zac's worst matchup in the slice and the full-layer chart reads as though he is favoured through most of it. The content chart matches the data; the full chart does not.
audit.corrected: Aligned the full layer to the content chart — Garen through first item, Zac at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] pairs "Pick up blobs to sustain" with a body about Garen wasting Courage, and dontsFull[1] pairs "Fight through his W" with "Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown".
audit.why: The recurring generator template mismatch. Present in every Zac entry I audited.
audit.corrected: Re-pointed both bodies at their titles; the Courage body now names the tenacity and damage reduction that make fighting through W a mistake.

edits.after: Garen peaks at 6 — Demacian Justice hits harder the lower your health falls.

notes: Densest set of factual errors in the slice. (1) Judgment is tagged (W) in three strings; it is Garen's E, and his W is Courage — the full layer tells the player to track Courage while the content layer tells them Courage is the spin. The suspectNames scan cannot catch this because it compares ability names and ignores the slot letter in parentheses; a slot-vs-name cross-check would be a cheap addition to that tool and would likely find more across other champions. (2) Demacian Justice was described as scaling with GAREN's missing HP — it scales with the target's, so the safety rule was inverted. (3) "Villain marks" appears twice; Villain is not in Garen's current kit and does not appear anywhere in Riot's description. That is the second stale-mechanic reference in this slice after Mundo's "Adrenaline", both in wants/spikes text, which suggests the generator drew on outdated champion knowledge for those fields specifically. (4) content.early claimed Perseverance "erases any poke you land" — backwards; the passive only ticks while he is untouched, and Zac's W on a 5s cooldown denies it outright. That inverted a winning plan into a reason not to poke. The flagged missing-sequencing defect is addressed with three concrete rules (Courage 22s, Decisive Strike 8s slow-break, W denies Perseverance). NOT ASSERTED: whether Demacian Justice's execute kills through Cell Division's bloblet state — the previous text claimed it "beats your revive" and I removed that claim rather than restate it, because revive interaction is not in Riot's text and I could not verify it. Also left alone: whether Courage's tenacity shortens Zac's knockup specifically, since knockups are conventionally tenacity-immune; my line says tenacity and damage reduction blunt the combo without claiming it shortens the displacement.
